en: Mm... Oh! {player}! You caught me napping. I've been out watching trainers all day.
text: Mm... A! {player}! M-ai prins moțăind. Am urmărit antrenori toată ziua.

en: I'd much rather be watching a battle than sleeping, mind you. Have you been to the Contest Hall yet?
text: Aș prefera să urmăresc o luptă decât să dorm, de fapt. Ai fost deja la Sala Concursurilor?

en: Lilycove's full of strong trainers. You'll have no shortage of battles here, {player}.
text: Lilycove e plin de antrenori puternici. N-o să duci lipsă de lupte aici, {player}.
